title: VUA recipe-export result v0.1 (project draft document)
description: Result document for the recipe-export v0.1 read face (proposal 029 B-face freeze loop 1, 2026-09-22). The envelope mirrors the standing wire shape (schemaVersion/operation/result): the envelope const is the word-list-row family version 0.1; the result document carries its own family const vua.recipe-export/v0.1 — the two versions are independent (c914cf2 standing rule: every wire row cites a version constant of its own). The result IS the Recipe project DRAFT: a draft-seed document, never a Recipe. Honesty ruling pinned by shape: the recipe v0.3 document face requires assets/instances minItems 1 and every asset to carry an entityRef or sourceRef, so an honest empty skeleton cannot exist as a Recipe document without fabricating identities — the draft is therefore its own frozen type with NO recipeId (minted only by the save chain when the user explicitly confirms), NO title, NO assets/instances/relations/wardrobeGroups and NO locked block. Deterministic export map (v0.1): origin echoes the 013 inspection facts verbatim (projectPath, project name or null, the vuaIdentity tri-state); environment.unityVersionConstraint carries the observed editor version verbatim or null when unreadable; dependencies rows are the manifest's DECLARED dependencies (packageId ascending — a frozen deterministic presentation fact, like packages-query) with versionConstraint verbatim from the declaration and lockedVersion carrying the exact locked pin when the same id exists in the locked map (locked-only entries are transitive resolution facts, not user intents, and are out of this face's vocabulary). The missing list is the draft's honesty core: a closed ten-value enum; the nine structural/semantic dimensions (assets, instances, relations, wardrobeGroups, targetAvatar, assetRoles, assetLabels, sourceRefs, titleSemantics) are ALWAYS absent in v0.1 (zero-bridge ruling, proposal 029 open item 4 option B) and each is pinned present via contains; environmentUnityVersion is present IF AND ONLY IF unityVersionConstraint is null (both implications pinned). additionalProperties:false everywhere is the false-assertion guard: a draft carrying assets, a title, a recipeId, an optional flag on a dependency row, or any other invented field is INVALID by schema, not merely discouraged.

draftId.description: The draft instance identity, minted per export call. This is NOT a recipeId: the Recipe identity is minted only when the user explicitly confirms and saves through the standing recipe.save version chain — a draft never carries one (negative vector pinned).

exportedAt.description: The instant the export scan completed (RFC 3339, VUA-side fact).

dependencies.description: The manifest's declared dependencies projected as draft dependency rows, sorted by packageId ascending (frozen deterministic presentation fact). An EMPTY array is a valid, honest answer (manifest absent or zero declared dependencies) — absence is never padded with guesses.

missing.description: The missing-dimension list — the draft's honesty core and the confirmation flow's required rendering (project-exported draft + missing-dimension list, proposal 029 B-face). Closed ten-value enum; the nine structural/semantic dimensions are constant members of every v0.1 draft (zero-bridge ruling: the relation face is never scanned in v0.1, and design intent — roles, labels, title semantics — is never asserted by an export); environmentUnityVersion joins exactly when the editor version was unreadable.

projectPath.description: The registered project path, echoed verbatim (the proposal-013 identity).

projectName.description: The project name as the 013 inspection aggregate observed it, verbatim; null when no name fact is readable. A source fact only — the draft has NO title field, and whether the confirmation flow prefills a title input from this name is a desktop presentation decision (proposal 029 open item 2 territory stays open).

vuaIdentityStatus.description: The VUA-native identity tri-state (`.vua/project.json`), verbatim from the 013 inspection aggregate (v0.2 additive finding). An applicability note only — never a gate in v0.1: whether an absent identity triggers a desktop difference prompt is presentation, ruling still open (proposal 029 open item 2).

unityVersionConstraint.description: The editor version observed on disk, verbatim (e.g. the ProjectVersion.txt content) — recorded as-is, no version migration (proposal 029 boundary 2); null when unreadable, in which case the missing list MUST carry environmentUnityVersion (both iff implications pinned at projectDraft level). No capabilities field: no producer fact exists in v0.1 (ORC-DEV-004).

packageId.description: The VPM package identifier (the manifest key), verbatim. No tighter pattern is frozen: the word list transports facts, it does not re-litigate upstream id grammar.

versionConstraint.description: The declared version constraint, verbatim from the manifest's dependencies declaration (e.g. a range like 3.7.x).

lockedVersion.description: The exact locked pin for the same packageId from the manifest's locked map, when present. Absent when the declaration has no locked pin. Locked-only entries (in locked but never declared) do not produce rows in v0.1 — they are transitive resolution facts, not user-declared intents.

missingDimension.description: Closed set of dimensions a v0.1 export never asserts. Nine are constant (the relation face five — assets, instances, relations, wardrobeGroups, targetAvatar — plus the semantic four — assetRoles, assetLabels, sourceRefs, titleSemantics); environmentUnityVersion is the conditional tenth. A draft claiming any of these dimensions was exported is INVALID by construction (negative vector pinned via the top-level additionalProperties:false too: carrying assets/instances arrays is schema-invalid).
